scripts.dev:infisical: infisical run --env=dev --path=/survei-kemenag -- concurrently -k -n "BE,FE" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "cd backend && %USERPROFILE%\go\bin\air.exe" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:no-air: node scripts/run-infisical.cjs concurrently -n "BE,FE" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "cd backend && go run main.go" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/run-infisical.cjs cd backend && go run main.go
scripts.dev:frontend: node scripts/run-infisical.cjs cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build:frontend: node scripts/run-infisical.cjs cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && go build -o bin/server main.go
